values.note: ReserveAmerica describes a 91-site campground (mass.gov's location page says 89) and lists 79 bookable sites plus 6 yurts and a group site: 50 tent-only, 19 Standard Non Electric (to 20-40 ft) and 10 Standard Electric (32 ft). All RV driveways are back-in; 27 sites take 25 ft or more, 12 of them 40 ft. DCR's text says eleven electric sites; the fee table and the booking site show ten.

note: MA DCR Lorraine Park (Loraine) Campground in Harold Parker State Forest, Andover; campers-only dump station. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $17/$54 + $6 electric (2026 table) and 2026 season 5/7-10/25 (unchanged); 10 public electric sites, all 20/30/50 amp (DCR text says eleven; fee table and RA show ten); spigot at every site; no sewer; dump, showers, flush toilets; max 40 ft, all back-in; reservations required; 14-day cumulative limit. Note cleaned of field facts. Most sites are tent-only (50 of 79 bookable).
